target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28 with AWS and Capital One SWE internships, an Amazon client contract, and a C++ matching engine at 1.26M events/sec. Strong for an intern.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Several bullets stop at mechanism or intent (AWS policies, search index, PhysTwin pipeline, Bedrock retraining); the reader has to guess the outcome.

must_fix: Clarify the AWS bullet's current state: say what stage it's at (e.g., backtested vs. deployed) so it doesn't read as an open-ended task
PhysTwin bullet ends on 'tuned the VLM's prompts': tuned toward what? Clarify the purpose or cut that clause

bullets.quote: Balancing Amazon Redshift availability against cost by writing
bullets.issue: Strong tradeoff framing, but no stage or outcome; reads as ongoing task. Lead with the action.
bullets.suggestion: Writing and backtesting Java policies that tune upper/lower bounds on EC2 capacity reserved for Redshift operations like patching, balancing availability against cost

bullets.quote: Rebuilt a legacy test-data workflow builder in React/TypeScript
Precomputed a tree-style search index over popular workflows
bullets.issue: Good design decision, but ends at intent; 'under access limits' is vague. Say what constraint drove precomputation.
bullets.suggestion: Precomputed a tree-style search index over popular workflows from a 270K+ row PostgreSQL table (Python/SQLAlchemy, Redis cache) so lookups avoided DB queries under access limits

bullets.quote: Cut LLM workflow generation time 65% to under
Shipped a space-research tool used by Amazon Leo's
bullets.issue: Handoff to client engineers is the impact; deployment stack is tech-listy. Lead with ownership and handoff.
bullets.suggestion: Shipped a space-research tool for Amazon Leo's public-policy team, deployed on AWS Fargate (Docker) via GitHub Actions + CDK and handed off to Leo engineers who now maintain it

bullets.quote: Reduced end-to-end latency 34% for a pipeline
Automated fine-tuning of a Bedrock source-relevancy model on
bullets.issue: Gating redundant retraining is the interesting decision; say what the gate checks. Otherwise the AWS service list overshadows it.

bullets.quote: Built a Python pipeline for PhysTwin, a PhD-led
bullets.issue: Dense and colon-chained; your ownership is unclear and 'tuned the VLM's prompts' has no purpose.
bullets.suggestion: Built the Python perception pipeline for PhysTwin (PhD-led digital twin, targeting ICLR): runs AnyGrasp on multi-camera images and renders grasps as Open3D overlays fed to a VLM

bullets.quote: Shortened research-environment setup time 30% with uv
bullets.issue: Two unrelated actions in one bullet; profiling clause has no outcome.
bullets.suggestion: Cut research-environment setup time 30% via uv dependency pinning and Docker; added psutil time/memory profiling and Pytest suites to locate bottlenecks

bullets.quote: Co-founded a 110+ member campus product studio
Building a RAG meal-suggestion feature for the official
Engineered a C++17 order book and matching engine
Benchmarked B+ tree vs LSM skip-list stores
bullets.issue: 'the simulation's event logs' is ambiguous here; tie it to the replay so it's clearly the same project.

structure.change: Consider moving the 1.26M events/sec bullet to second position in the IEX project, directly after correctness
structure.rationale: Correctness then throughput is the natural story; the storage benchmark is a secondary design study.
Grad date and school are needed in the 7-second skim for intern filtering.

top3: Clarify: AWS bullet — state what stage the policies reached (backtested/shipped) and lead with the action verb rather than 'Balancing'
Rework the PhysTwin bullet so your ownership and the purpose of the VLM prompt tuning are clear
Clarify: what the Bedrock retraining gate checks — it's your best design decision in that role and is currently buried behind service names
